summary: Archangel Ventures partners with founders across Australia from day one. Its Our Approach page says the firm deploys the majority of its capital at pre-seed and seed, is generalist by design and sector-agnostic but mission-aligned, and offers candid advice and network access. Portfolio pages include Heidi Health, Atelier and Pearler, and the homepage links application forms and a 2026 fund. Cheque size and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: Featured on the homepage as a portfolio company (AI care partner for clinicians), with a post on backing Heidi. Round and date are not stated on the homepage.
